zh_CN: BONUS是一款将骰子和扑克玩法结合在一起的扑克游戏，适合2至4人。在玩法上类似于“斗地主”等传统扑克玩法；在一局游戏里，谁先将手牌打完谁就获胜。
en: BONUS is a card game that combines dice and playing cards for 2 to 4 players. Like traditional shedding games such as Dou Dizhu, the first player to empty their hand wins.

zh_CN: 游戏一共会用到包括大小王的两副牌，一共108张，开始每人会发到17张。其中，3最小，然后是4、5、...、K、A，一直到最大的2。跟花色没有关系。\n不过「小王」和「大王」在单独打出或成对打出的时候可以比2大，也可以放在其它牌型里当作「万能牌」。
en: The game uses two complete decks including jokers, for 108 cards total. Each player starts with 17 cards. Rank is independent of suit: 3 is the lowest, followed by 4, 5, ..., K, A, and finally 2.\nWhen played alone or as a pair, the small and big jokers can beat 2. They can also act as wildcards within other hand types.

zh_CN: 每一局游戏会从你开始。轮到任何一个人的时候，都要先投掷一枚「骰子」，并根据骰子的点数选择出牌或过牌。点击屏幕任意位置即可投骰子。
en: Every match starts with you. At the start of a player's round they roll a die, then either play or pass based on the result. Click anywhere on the screen to roll.

zh_CN: 哦，是5！那就说明现在需要打出5张牌——你可以选择「四带一」、「三带二」，或者「顺子」，也就是五张连续的牌。
en: Oh, a 5! You now need to play five cards: four with one, a triple with a pair, or a straight of five consecutive cards.

zh_CN: 用「鼠标左键」选中你想打出的牌，之后点击上方的「出牌」按钮，就能将牌打出到中间。之后你的对手会尝试跟你的牌。\n当然，你也可以选择不出，那么点击「不出」按钮即可。此时对手可以按照你的点数出牌。
en: Use the left mouse button to select the cards you want to play, then click Play above to send them to the center. Your opponents will then try to beat your hand.\nYou may also choose not to play by clicking Pass. Your opponents may then play according to your die result.

zh_CN: 哇，你触发了一次BONUS！这是在你的回合中，你打出的牌被「全部PASS」的时候所触发的特殊阶段。在BONUS阶段你可以任意出牌一次，不过依然要符合规则里的牌型。以及，BONUS不会连续触发，接下来无论如何还是要投骰子。
en: Wow, you triggered BONUS! This special phase begins when everyone passes after a play made in your round. During BONUS you may play any one legal hand. BONUS cannot trigger consecutively; the next round still begins with a die roll.

zh_CN: 哇，有人触发了一次BONUS！这是在某人回合中，其打出的牌被「全部PASS」的时候所触发的特殊阶段。在BONUS阶段可以任意出牌一次，不过依然要符合规则里的牌型。以及，BONUS不会连续触发，接下来无论如何还是要投骰子。
en: Wow, another player triggered BONUS! This special phase begins when everyone passes after a play made in a player's round. During BONUS they may play any one legal hand. BONUS cannot trigger consecutively; the next round still begins with a die roll.

zh_CN: 哦......看来大家都不是很想要出牌。那么你只能摸三张牌了。摸完牌后，会逆时针轮到下一位玩家。
en: Oh... it looks like nobody wanted to play. You must draw three cards. After drawing, play continues counterclockwise with the next player.

zh_CN: 哦......看来大家都不是很想要出牌。这个时候最开始投骰子的玩家会摸三张牌。摸完牌后，会逆时针轮到下一位玩家。
en: Oh... it looks like nobody wanted to play. In this case, the player who rolled the die at the start of the round draws three cards. Afterward, play continues counterclockwise with the next player.

zh_CN: 轮到其它玩家也一样，先投骰子，再根据骰子的结果出牌，或者不出。
en: Other players follow the same sequence: roll first, then play according to the result or pass.

zh_CN: 出牌的时候，需要在牌型相同的情况下（三/四/五/六条除外）用点数更大的牌盖过其他人的牌，最后谁的牌最大，就由谁继续下一个回合——继续投骰子，出牌......如此往复，直到有人把牌打完。
en: To cover a play, use a higher-ranked hand of the same type. Three-, four-, five-, and six-of-a-kind are exceptions: they can beat other hand types with the same card count. Whoever played the highest hand leads the next round, rolls, and plays again. This continues until someone empties their hand.

zh_CN: 以及，再提醒你一下：大小王可以当万能牌哦！但是如果在最后一次出牌的时候使用了万能牌，就会再摸两张牌......\n如果你对牌型有疑问，可以点击右上角的「牌型」查看详情。在「设置」里也可以调整一些游戏的内容。
en: One more reminder: jokers can act as wildcards! But if your final play uses a wildcard, you'll draw two more cards...\nIf you are unsure about a hand type, click Hand Types in the top-right corner for details. You can also adjust parts of the game under Settings.

zh_CN: 接下来就靠你自己打了，祝你好运！
en: The rest is up to you. Good luck!
